messages:
anna_security: Noticed a small spike in decrypt failures against the envelope service after the KEK rotation at ~11:00 UTC. Errors concentrated 11:03–11:07. Anyone else seeing this?
devon_infra: saw ~120 failed decrypts (~0.07% of ops) from embed-cache-worker. Logs show "ciphertext_version_mismatch" and a header version of v1 on some items.
priya_platform: is the manual rewrap job still running? I kicked one off for wave-1 at 11:01.
anna_security: rewrap completed for wave-1 but wave-2 backlog was still processing when failures started. Suspect some nodes interpreting the KEK header differently during the transition.
oliver_sre: rolling back the KEK would be messy and risky. Can we grant a short-lived RBAC exception to the rewrap service account to allow dual-decrypt/double-write? @devon_infra any concerns?
devon_infra: we can add a scoped IAM policy: allow kms:Decrypt for a specific KEK arn with a condition tag like "rewrap=allowed" and timebox it. Patch suggestion below:
```
resource "aws_iam_policy" "rewrap_tmp" {
  name = "rewrap-temp"
  policy = <<POL
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/KEK-ID","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ResourceTag/rewrap":"allowed"}}}]
}
POL
}
```
priya_platform: +1 to limited RBAC. Also propose we bump KMS audit log verbosity for the next 4 hours to capture decrypt calls and caller identities so we can trace which nodes hit old vs new header parsing.
anna_security: will enable short-lived audit verbosity and add a metric on decrypt error types and header_version observed.
devon_infra: watch embedding cache TTLs — if a cached ciphertext carrying the old header persists, on-read decrypt will fail. We have re-encrypt-on-read logic in the store-proxy, but looks like a couple of nodes didn't pick up the proxy update in the last deploy.
priya_platform: I'm redeploying store-proxy to the remaining nodes in wave-2 now; ETA ~5m.
oncall: starting targeted rewrap for shards s3/42 and s3/43 now in canary. Will report results.
deploy-bot: canary rewrap job started by @oncall (job_id: rw-2026-176314).
anna_security: for the postmortem, we should surface the tradeoffs: auto rewrap on KEK rotation vs manual rewrap. Auto reduces the mismatch window but increases blast radius and can surprise downstream services. Manual gives control but needs orchestration, RBAC pre-approvals, and better telemetry.
priya_platform: also need to document backward-compat header handling: older clients should gracefully attempt old-key decrypt paths when they detect header_version mismatch instead of failing only.
devon_infra: if we consider auto rewrap, we must build traffic-safety controls: staggered waves, per-region rate limits, and automatic fallback to read-only for a small window if rewrap rate exceeds safe thresholds.
oliver_sre: action items: 1) enable audit-verbosity (anna) 2) apply temp RBAC for rewrap role (devon) 3) finish store-proxy deploy (priya) 4) targeted rewrap for failed shards (oncall). I'll follow up with a short timeline and an after-action note. Please @channel in #incidents if decrypt errors spike >0.5% in next 2h. :thumbsup:
